name: The Holy City of $jerusalem$
description: Built in the 4th century under Emperor Constantine, the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in $jerusalem$ encompasses both Golgotha and the tomb of Christ. It became the holiest site in [ShowReligionGroupName('christian')] and its most important pilgrimage center. Despite periods of destruction and reconstruction, it has remained in shared $christian_ADJ$ custody.

name: Saint Peter in the Vatican
description: The original Papal Basilica of Saint Peter in the Vatican in [ShowLocationName('rome')] was commissioned by Emperor Constantine in the 4th century over the tomb of Saint Peter, the first $catholic_pope$. It became the principal church of Western [ShowReligionGroupName('christian')] and the seat of papal authority. It also is one of the main centers of pilgrimage for [ShowReligionName('catholic')].

name: Ranganathaswamy Temple
description: The Ranganathaswamy Temple in Srirangam is one of the largest and holiest $hindu_ADJ$ temple complexes in India. Dedicated to the god $vishnu_god$ as Ranganatha, it dates at least from the early Chola period, with later extensions by the Pandya and Vijayanagara rulers. By 1337, it is a major pilgrimage center in Southern India, known for its vast precincts, imposing gopurams, and rich religious endowment.

name: Bodh Gayā
description: The Mahābodhi Mahāvihāra marks the spot where Siddhartha Gautama attained enlightenment under the Bodhi Tree. Originally built by Emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BC, it has undergone several restorations over time. Its distinctive brick structure is one of the earliest examples of $buddhist_ADJ$ temple architecture in India.

name: Al-Masjid al-Ḥarām
description: Located in [ShowLocationName('mecca')] and most commonly known as al-Ka'ba, the $kaaba$ is the most sacred shrine of [ShowReligionGroupName('muslim')]. Covered by a black cloth known as Kiswah, it defines the direction of prayer (qibla) for all $muslim_ADJ$ prayers.

name: $cholollan$ Holy City
description: The Great Pyramid of [ShowLocationName('cholollan')] was built in successive stages during hundreds of years. Dedicated to the deity [ShowGodName('quetzalcoatl_god')], it is the largest pyramid in the region. Even after the city's decline, it remained a sacred and cultural site for local inhabitants.

name: Temple of Confucius
description: The $temple_of_confucius$ in [ShowLocationName('qufu')], was originally built in 478 BC to honor the philosopher Confucius. Expanded repeatedly during successive dynasties, it became one of the largest temple complexes in China.

name: Enryaku-ji
description: Founded in 788 AD on Mount Hiei by the monk Saichō, $enryaku_ji$ became the headquarters of the $SECT_TENDAI_NAME$ school of Japanese [ShowReligionGroupName('buddhist')]. It was a powerful monastic center that housed thousands of warrior monks and influenced the affairs of [ShowLocationName('kyoto')].
